description: AgentShield structured policy rules. Each rule defines a condition and a decision (BLOCK, ASK_APPROVAL, or ALLOW). Enabled matching rules are collected and the most restrictive decision wins. If no rule matches, the default decision is ALLOW.

rules.name: Private file to external recipient
rules.description: Block sending private or internal file contents to external email recipients.

checks.description: Email body or attachment contains content sourced from a file read via read_file.
Recipient email address is not in the user's organization or approved contact list.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Attempted to send private file contents to external recipient {arguments.to}. This violates the data exfiltration policy.

rules.name: File deletion without explicit approval
rules.description: Require explicit user approval before executing any file deletion.

checks.description: Any delete_file call triggers this rule regardless of context.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: Agent proposed deleting file {arguments.file_path}. File deletion requires explicit user confirmation.

rules.name: Secrets or credentials to external URL
rules.description: Block transmitting secrets, API keys, passwords, tokens, or credentials to external endpoints.

checks.description: Tool call arguments contain patterns matching secrets or credentials.
Target URL or email recipient is an external endpoint.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Detected secret or credential pattern in arguments being sent to external target. This violates the credential protection policy.

rules.name: Untrusted context instruction override
rules.description: Block actions where instructions in external context override the user's original intent.

checks.description: The proposed tool call action does not match the user's original request.
External context contains patterns typical of prompt injection attempts.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Detected prompt injection pattern in external context. The proposed action deviates from the user's original request and appears to be driven by injected instructions.

rules.name: Unauthorized external HTTP requests
rules.description: Block HTTP requests to URLs not explicitly mentioned or approved by the user.

checks.description: The target URL was not mentioned in the user's original request.
The URL points to an external domain, not an internal or approved service.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: HTTP request to {arguments.url} was not requested by the user and appears to originate from external context. Unauthorized external requests are blocked by policy.

rules.name: Sensitive data in shared events or tasks
rules.description: Require approval when calendar events or tasks contain sensitive information and include external participants.

checks.description: Event or task body contains potentially sensitive information (financial data, credentials, internal project details).
The event/task includes external participants or is set to public visibility.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: Calendar event or task contains potentially sensitive content and includes external participants. Please confirm this is intended.

rules.name: Internal information in public GitHub issues
rules.description: Require approval when a GitHub issue may expose internal-only information in a public repository.

checks.description: Issue body references internal systems, credentials, private URLs, or proprietary information.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: GitHub issue may contain internal information and the target repository is public. Please confirm before creating.

rules.name: Bulk or destructive operations
rules.description: Require approval for operations affecting multiple files or resources in a single action.

checks.description: The tool call targets more than one resource.
The operation is part of a batch affecting multiple resources.

rules.explanation_template: Approval required: This operation affects multiple resources. Bulk or destructive operations require explicit user confirmation.

rules.name: Unauthorized file deletion
rules.description: Block file deletion when the user requested a read-only, listing, or otherwise non-destructive action.

checks.description: The proposed delete_file action does not match the user's original request.

rules.explanation_template: Blocked: Agent proposed a file deletion that does not match the user's request. Destructive actions that exceed explicit user intent are blocked.
